findings.detail: The question has the same problem as earlier question M4-S09-T2. Both ask for the cause of an added 'only report high-confidence findings' line failing to give precision. In both, the answer comes from the same reasoning: a confidence instruction is not a categorical criterion. Moving the setting from contract extraction to CI review and adding the detail of lost race conditions does not change the problem. The wrong option C (instruction worded too mildly, needs a stricter demand) also repeats the mild-wording distractor of M4-S09-T2.

blind_answer.reason: Confidence-based filtering doesn't target issue categories: style remarks are easy to be confident about and survive, while subtle race conditions are harder to confirm and get dropped. Explicit categorical criteria (report bugs/security, skip style) are needed. A is false, C is the same flawed approach with a number attached, and D is unlikely because PR size didn't change.
